{{Quote|I speak of none other than Inquisitor Kuno Josard, an important figure in the Inquisitorius. You must be especially careful while in his presence. Say as little as possible and clear your mind. It is said he can read your very thoughts. |Tour Aryon|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Kuno Josard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuno Josard was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
